messages:
zara_marketing: Hey team — rapid design sprint request for the "Inference Playbook" webinar next Thursday. Small, re-usable kit needed.
zara_marketing: Deliverables (ranked): 1) hero artboard (1600x900 static + 3s loop GIF + 120x120 SVG loader), 2) concise swimlane routing diagram for registration page (1200x600), 3) three micro-tiles for socials (1080x1080, 1200x628, 320x480), 4) 4-frame micro-storyboard (1080x1080 frames) for IG, 5) one-page host pacing + speaker cues. Also provide SVG + PNG fallbacks and alt-text notes.
mike_design: Got it. Two colorways (brand blue / neutral). Export weight target: PNGs <200kb where feasible. Any strict copy or legal flags?
zara_marketing: Core copy below. Paid CTA: "Register now". Organic CTA: "Learn more". Headline options: A) "Predictable inference. Measured cost." B) "Serve reliably at scale — lower unit cost." Use A for paid, B for organic.
jana_growth: For micro-tiles, we need paid/organic variants and a paid overlay with CTA for 1080x1080 and 600x200. Also add a 1:1 crop for in-app promos (1080x1080).
devin_prod: Routing content: registration form -> scoring -> premium queue (score >= 80) | standard queue -> AE assignment. After 48h unassigned -> SDR. Expose CRM tag "inference_use_case" on public diagram. Public labels: "Premium" / "Standard" only. If helpful, JSON snippet: { "lead_source": "webinar", "score_threshold": 80, "routing": "premium|standard|SDR" }
sasha_legal: Quick legal note: any comparative or multiplier claim needs review. If you use phrasing like "up to 3x cheaper" add qualifier "typical workloads" and flag in figma notes. I can review hero copy within 24h.
mike_design: Plan: I'll drop hero sketches (light/dark) + routing sketch by Tue 09:00 PT, then tiles + storyboard roughs by Tue 14:00. Will include alt text fields in Figma. For the loader: simple token pulse, 8-10fps, SVG animation + GIF fallback.
zara_marketing: Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/inference-playbook-kit (marketing team access). Name frames with asset_code and CTA variant.
jana_growth: Add a one-slide "methodology" visual for a supporting tweet thread — single-column, callout for "simulated conversational routing" and a short note: "Median latency ~60ms; caching + batching reduces unit cost ~2.6x (typical workloads)." Mark as illustrative.
mike_design: Noted. Will mark that slide as "illustrative" and add footer text: "Data shown for illustration only."
devin_prod: Small dev ask: for the interactive hero embed on the registration page we prefer a ready-made animated SVG + CSS snippet. Avoid heavy JS.
mike_design: Will deliver an inline-friendly SVG and a minified CSS keyframe example.
sasha_legal: Once hero copy is in figma, tag me and I'll review. If the benchmark uses internal tests, please add the small footer.
zara_marketing: Deadline: first pass by Tue noon PT, final assets by Wed EOD. Priority: hero + routing diagram > micro-tiles > storyboard > pacing sheet.
uploader-bot: Uploaded figma://inference-playbook/1791112222 (preview: https://figma-preview.example/1791112222) :white_check_mark:
mike_design: I'll tag you on each update. Any other blockers?
jana_growth: Can we also get a 600x200 low-priority paid banner? Good to have.
mike_design: Adding 600x200 to the deliverables list.
zara_marketing: Thanks everyone. Tag me on uploads and ping Sasha for legal when hero copy is finalized. End.
